CLI: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -B -m htfp_launch_manifest DOSSIER.json; exactly one explicit regular-file path,no stdin/default/URL/fetch/apply/output-file options. Help/invalid arguments return fixed CLI_USAGE report exit2. JSON stdout only,one trailing LF,no normal stderr or traceback. Read at most65537bytes. Exit0means no documentary contradiction,not readiness.
error_phase_order: strict UTF-8 and stdlib JSON parse/hooks(first encountered duplicate/nonfinite/number event; syntax INVALID_JSON; decoder recursion NESTING_LIMIT)
Unicode scalar validation(all keys/strings,INVALID_TEXT at $),container depth/assertion limit
unknown keys then declared fields lexicographically at each object; assertion items input index order; fractions member domains then denominator positivity

execution_accounting.product_boundary: Agent verification/evidence-runner limits only. Product CLI has no role/campaign ledger,invocation quota,free-disk gate or test lock; bounded input grammar is separate.
execution_accounting.recommended_plan: About100cases per full author/root campaign,including handpicked/generated/CLI/probes/failures; independent oracle later. Preallocate prospective attempt rows before every externally initiated target verification call/CLI process,including help/failures/retries/helper probes. Nested helpers in the same invocation are not double-counted. Retain started/completed/exit/report/source hashes and all failures; orphan blocks continuation; no resets. Lossless gzip of complete case input/stdout records at initial generation is allowed to fit budget. No target imports/probes during design.

file_open: Open the explicit path read-only/nonblocking,then fstat the opened descriptor before reading; require a regular file and close on every path. Nonregular FIFO/socket/device/directory and unreadable files yield INPUT_UNREADABLE without blocking/data read. A symlink is permitted only when its opened target descriptor is regular.

finding_catalog.ACTIVATION_EPOCH_MISMATCH: Supplied activation epoch differs from scheduling epoch plus two.
finding_catalog.ALLOCATION_OVER_NOMINAL: Supplied allocation amounts exceed fixed nominal issuance.
finding_catalog.ATTRIBUTED_ASSERTION_UNVERIFIED: Supplied claim and any approval or verification label remain unverified.
finding_catalog.COMPLETED_ALLOCATION_SHORTFALL: Completed allocation amounts fall below fixed nominal issuance.
finding_catalog.COMPLETION_MISSING_AMOUNTS: Completed allocation assertion lacks all four explicit amounts.
finding_catalog.EPOCH_RELATION_OVERFLOW: Scheduling epoch plus two cannot fit an unsigned 64-bit activation epoch.
finding_catalog.EXTERNAL_GATE_UNVERIFIED: Offline documentary checks do not establish this external prerequisite.
finding_catalog.FUNDING_RATIO_MISMATCH: Supplied funding leg differs from its exactly representable confirmed share.
finding_catalog.FUNDING_TOTAL_MISMATCH: Intended pool and reserve lamports do not sum to gross raised lamports.
finding_catalog.INITIAL_CREDIT_EXCEEDS_CAPACITY: Candidate initial gross-sale credit exceeds candidate shared capacity.
finding_catalog.LP_LOCK_FRACTION_MISMATCH: Intended lock fraction is not100% of actually received initial LP.
finding_catalog.MISSING_INPUT: Dossier field is missing; no value is inferred.
finding_catalog.OPEN_CHOICE: Supplied candidate remains an unresolved production choice under the frozen sources.
finding_catalog.PARTIAL_ALLOCATION: Draft allocation remains below nominal; unallocated quantity is not assigned.
finding_catalog.PERSONAL_WALLET_MISMATCH: The two intended personal revenue wallet keys differ.
finding_catalog.POLICY_MISMATCH: Supplied intent contradicts a confirmed policy value.
finding_catalog.PROVISIONAL_CHOICE: Supplied candidate remains provisional under the frozen sources.
finding_catalog.ROUNDING_UNRESOLVED: Exact 80/20 integer lamport shares are impossible; no rounding decision is inferred.

finding_paths.FUNDING_RATIO_MISMATCH: funding.pool_lamports or funding.reserve_lamports,one per mismatching supplied leg

finding_sources: POLICY_MISMATCH uses fixed_policy_checks[path].source_ids; relationship findings use that relationship source_ids; missing/open/provisional leaves use their group_source_ids; external gate uses external_gate_source_ids; attributed assertions use S98,S99.

grammar.absence: All group leaf fields are optional and nullable. Missing/null is MISSING, never a default. An omitted/null group means its fields are absent. assertions omitted/null means no attributed assertions. Unknown keys at every level are invalid.
grammar.fraction: Exactly {numerator:u64,denominator:u64},denominator>0. No reduction,alpha<=1,positive numerator/rate/capacity or production-value restriction is inferred.
grammar.pubkey: Canonical Base58 decoding to exactly32bytes,alphabet123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz; re-encoding equal; syntactic only,no key/control/curve/ownership claim.
grammar.required_shape_errors: A nonnull fraction missing numerator/denominator is TYPE_MISMATCH at the fraction path; assertion missing required subject/claim is TYPE_MISMATCH at assertions[index]. Unknown keys still fail UNKNOWN_FIELD first at the nearest declared object.
grammar.text: Nonempty UTF-8 text<=512encodedbytes,no C0control or DEL characters; no source/evidence reference is opened.
grammar.u64: Canonical ASCII string 0 or [1-9][0-9]*,1..20digits,value<=18446744073709551615; no JSON number literal is accepted anywhere.
grammar.unicode: Every decoded JSON string/key must contain Unicode scalar values only. Reject any unpaired U+D800..U+DFFF surrogate with INVALID_TEXT at $,before UTF-8 length encoding or schema traversal; valid escaped surrogate pairs decoding to a scalar remain ordinary text.

input_errors.CLI_USAGE: Pass exactly one local JSON dossier path.
input_errors.COLLECTION_LIMIT: Dossier collection exceeds the supported bound.
input_errors.DUPLICATE_KEY: Duplicate JSON object keys are unsupported.
input_errors.INPUT_UNREADABLE: The explicit dossier cannot be read as a regular local file.
input_errors.INVALID_INTEGER: Expected a canonical unsigned 64-bit decimal string.
input_errors.INVALID_JSON: The dossier is not valid JSON.
input_errors.INVALID_PUBKEY: Expected a canonical 32-byte Base58 public key.
input_errors.INVALID_TEXT: Text must be nonempty,bounded,and free of control characters.
input_errors.INVALID_UTF8: The dossier is not strict UTF-8 JSON.
input_errors.JSON_NUMBER_NOT_ALLOWED: Numeric fields must use canonical decimal strings.
input_errors.TYPE_MISMATCH: Dossier field has an unsupported type.

open_rules.candidate_fields: All supplied identity.mint/initializer/genesis_sha256/metadata_reference/metadata_mutability/extensions_description,allocation.lge/team/marketing/recipients_reference/entitlement_reference/remainder_reference,funding.rounding_rule_reference,market.opening_timestamp/extra_margin_seconds/slip_policy_reference/config_reference/locker_reference,volume.structure/alpha/capacity/refill/initial_credit/start/prestart values retain OPEN_CHOICE or PROVISIONAL_CHOICE regardless asserted approval. Detailed exact path list and codes below.
open_rules.missing_leaf: MISSING_INPUT at every absent/null leaf; source_ids are exactly group_source_ids for that leaf's top-level group, in the listed array order. The same group mapping applies to OPEN_CHOICE and PROVISIONAL_CHOICE; fixed/relationship source lists do not override it.
open_rules.no_approval: No caller label/reference changes fixed policy status,closes a decision or public gate,or upgrades documentary evidence.

relationship_checks.rule: Sum explicitly provided amounts only,against fixed nominal10000000000000000000. Above nominal always ALLOCATION_OVER_NOMINAL. Below nominal with complete false/null is PARTIAL_ALLOCATION,report exact unallocated_from_provided without assigning it. complete true requires all four amounts (else COMPLETION_MISSING_AMOUNTS); full supplied sum below nominal is COMPLETED_ALLOCATION_SHORTFALL. Nominal equality does not approve shares/recipients/entitlements.

If all three provided,pool+reserve must equal gross raised (FUNDING_TOTAL_MISMATCH). No maintenance/cost/observed backing subtraction. Partial fields stay missing. Zero totals are arithmetically valid,no funding or minimum conclusion.

Derive exact expected fractions4*N/5 andN/5 from supplied gross N. If N%5==0,compare each supplied leg against exact integer (FUNDING_RATIO_MISMATCH). If N%5!=0,always ROUNDING_UNRESOLVED,retain exact fractions and any supplied leg differences,choose no rounding/tolerance/destination and do not classify the ratio alone as confirmed or contradictory. Independently enforce total conservation. A supplied rounding reference does not close this question or approve supplied allocations.

If scheduling E supplied,derive E+2 exactly and require it<=u64max (EPOCH_RELATION_OVERFLOW otherwise,even when activation missing). If it fits and activation supplied,require activation==E+2 (ACTIVATION_EPOCH_MISMATCH otherwise). Missing E or missing activation without overflow gives MISSING. No epoch-to-wall-clock conversion; claimed epochs externally unverified.

If supplied,require numerator==denominator (LP_LOCK_FRACTION_MISMATCH otherwise). Its base is100%of actual initial received LP,never total escrow/minimum LP/later third-party LP. No LP quantities are generated.

If both supplied,require identical canonical public wallet keys (PERSONAL_WALLET_MISMATCH otherwise). Do not compare HTFP token-account/ATA addresses or assert wallet/person/control/creator/FeeKey ownership or claim routing.

If both supplied,initial_credit<=capacity (INITIAL_CREDIT_EXCEEDS_CAPACITY otherwise) as candidate internal consistency only. All structure/numbers/time/prestart remain provisional/open,including zero or alpha>1 candidates.

report.check: Exactly {rule_id,path,result}; one entry per fixed check and relationship,ordered as stated. result MATCH/CONTRADICTION/MISSING/OPEN/PROVISIONAL/ROUNDING_UNRESOLVED/NOT_EVALUATED. For relationships,path is exactly the relationship report_path; finding paths remain independently defined in finding_paths.
report.derived: Exactly optional keys: allocation_known_sum_base_units=sum explicitly provided4amounts(if any); allocation_unallocated_from_provided_base_units=nominal-known when<=nominal; allocation_overallocated_base_units=known-nominal only when positive; funding_sum_lamports=P+R when both supplied; funding_expected_pool_lamports={numerator:4*N,denominator:5},funding_expected_reserve_lamports={numerator:N,denominator:5} when gross N supplied; funding_pool_difference_numerator=5*P-4*N and funding_reserve_difference_numerator=5*R-N when operands supplied,implicit denominator5; activation_expected_epoch=E+2 whenever E supplied. All numerical components are canonical decimal strings; two difference numerators may be signed. Derived sums/products may exceed u64,never truncate. No other derived fields or allocations.
report.error: null except INPUT_INVALID,then exactly {code,path,message}; fixed messages below; path is dot-separated declared field or $ for whole input/CLI.
report.finding: Exactly {code,path,source_ids,message}; bounded fixed messages,no arbitrary asserted text echo.
report.input_invalid: No partial assessment: checks/contradictions/open_items/unverified_assertions empty,derived empty. Emit first input error by error_phase_order,never traceback. Parser/whole-input/usage errors path $,schema errors path schema; declared field errors use field path,unknown-field errors nearest declared object parent.
report.input_sha256: SHA256 of exact full input bytes when read<=65536,including invalid JSON; null for missing/unreadable/nonregular/oversize/usage input.
report.policy_sources: Fixed map of DECISION_REGISTER.md,HTFP_FUNCTIONAL_SPEC.md,SECURITY_REQUIREMENTS.md,OPEN_QUESTIONS.md to source SHA256 below. References to frozen rule provenance,not runtime verification of local files/public state.
report.sorting: fixed checks lexicographic field path; relationships in listed order; contradictions/open_items sorted(path,code); external gates listed order then assertions input order.
